hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read file_path; if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.(rb|rake)$|^Gemfile'; then bundle exec standardrb --fix-unsafely "$file_path"; fi; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read file_path; if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.(js|ts|jsx|tsx|json|yml|yaml|css)$'; then pnpm prettier --write "$file_path"; fi; }
